observations.summary: prepare_fresh_private_sample_reserved duplicates the preparation algorithm and the owner's create test exercises only its NotReturned path. E3 (skip its final predicate) makes a create under a parent with an inheritable foreign allow return Ok with a foreign-readable file, unnoticed by owner tests; E4 (append to existing ACL) likewise. Preferred fix: one algorithm (reserved implementation with a kind parameter; prepare_fresh_private_sample as a thin work.effect wrapper) so existing prepare tests cover both; alternatively add create tests under an inheriting parent (foreign -> Access, nothing appended; owner -> accepted, unchanged). Before any caller.

The umask fix (set_permissions) is unpinned: E2 survives at the normal test umask; the security crate forbids unsafe so the test cannot set umask. Accept reviewer evidence (probe under umask 0277) or check in a child process with a restrictive umask.

Carried r1 O2: the parent is a kernel-resolved &Path (symlinks followed, C6; CWD-relative if relative). Before any caller, take an admitted RetainedDirectory and create handle-relatively (openat O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW).

The residual file after a later refusal is documented, but a retry with the same name fails AlreadyExists indefinitely; a handle-relative version could remove it on refusal after an inode identity check.
